# Paul Ivory

**Role:** First husband of Sheryle Telfer, father of Aaron, Jared, Lauren & Joel Ivory
**Born:** 12 December 1955
**Died:** 24 December 1996 (aged 41, suicide)
**Buried:** Great Northern Garden of Remembrance, Deception Bay QLD

## Life Summary

Paul Ivory was the first husband of [[Sheryle Telfer (1961–?)]] and father of four children: [[Aaron Paul Ivory (1989–?)]], Jared Mitchell Ivory (1986–1994), [[Lauren Maree Ivory (1994–?)]], and [[Joel Matthew Ivory (1986–?)]]. He passed away on Christmas Eve 1996.

His plaque reads:

> **PAUL** — Beloved husband of Sheryle, father of Joel, Aaron, Jared & Lauren — who died 24-12-96. 41 years.
